bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
active="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
enabled="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
health="$(python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health 2>&1 || true)"
session="deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session"
mode="$(test -f "$session" && stat -c '%a' "$session" || echo missing)"
limit="$(grep -E 'dialogs = await client.get_dialogs' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | head -1 || true)"
{ printf 'PR47_USERBOT_RECOVERY_STATE\nACTIVE=%s\nENABLED=%s\nSESSION_MODE=%s\nCLIENT_HEALTH=%s\nCODE_DIALOG_SETTING=%s\n' "$active" "$enabled" "$mode" "$(printf '%s' "$health" | grep -m1 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' || echo UNKNOWN)" "$limit"; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
